title: Crafting With Attitude
description: Makes crafting tables and a few other blocks annoying
body:
All this mod does is change how 4 of the blocks work, the crafting table and furnace just say some light-ish roasts, and the furnace and smoker are just unusable. This may sound like a bad mod, because it is, but I find it funny still. At the moment, there are just over 50 lines total for all 4 blocks.

Short Q and A:
Q: Why did you make this mod?
A: Because I wanted to.

Q: How does it work?
A: Some blocks say stuff in the chat when you interact with them.
end of Q and A (I said it was short)

Also, to be fully honest, no one asked for this mod; I just made it.

**Note**: I have no idea if there are any mods already out there that are similar or the same, but this is not a copy of any mod, nor was it based on any existing mod. This mod was made for entertainment purposes only, and that is it. (also some practice for my coding skills, but yeah.)

**NOTE**(2): Do not take anything the blocks say too seriously; none of it is targeted, and don't get upset with anything the blocks say; they can't hear or see you, and they only react to you interacting with the block.
